reviewed.disposition: Raw lstat identifies a Git repository candidate. It observes source/Git layout, not task or event authority.
Reads the shipped tgrep asset manifest under packageRoot and validates engine/platform asset metadata. This is distributed engine installation input.
Canonicalizes the repository root before normalizing bounded search output paths. No operational file writer; normalized results are repository-discovery output.
Canonicalizes repository root for repository-index readiness, setup and bounded search execution. Index source files and process metadata remain auxiliary repository discovery state.
Reads repository-index engine/serve/meta JSON and verifies source-root and process ownership for search status. These are auxiliary index/process records, not task artifacts or ledger state.

Uses canonical project root and bigint device/inode metadata for native connection leasing. Database replacement is refused while leases overlap; no filesystem operational artifact fallback or mirror writer.
Creates a private temporary SQLite backup and opens it read-only for isolated reads. Only owned live snapshots may be reused; snapshot handles and scratch directories are closed/removed in finally.
Creates and removes private temporary SQLite spill storage for primitive relation metadata/source positions. Spill relations are validation scratch rather than a second authoritative task store.
Reads filesystem topology metadata before SQLite creates storage/sidecars. Rejects named unsupported Linux network types and Windows UNC paths; the deny-list does not certify every other filesystem.

limitations: Direct raw-filesystem source roles only; complete delegated consumer and current platform acceptance are independent.
Evidence retained outside the checkout while full Mac814 source-manifest validation is live.
